hardCaps.publicInvariant: Tenant locations never leak, published Transitions are never rewritten under another revision, and migration preserves watermark and durable replay behavior.

specGaps.summary: The Manager does not publish exact status and error codes for cross-tenant, empty-member, unknown-RegionVersion, or effective-time bundle failures.
The Manager requires LocationEvent bundle pinning without publishing the FINAL LocationEvent wire shape.
The public contract exposes LEASED Work but no effect-complete or before-commit recovery checkpoint.
